inputs.message: What is my full name?

expected_facts: the full name stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Return the stored full name directly and do not add unrelated personal details.
must_not: invent or alter the stored name

inputs.message: What name do I prefer to go by?

expected_facts: the preferred name stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Return the stored preferred name, distinguishing it from the full legal name if necessary.

inputs.message: What is my GitHub profile?

expected_facts: the GitHub profile URL stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Return the stored GitHub profile URL without inferring other accounts.

inputs.message: What university do I attend and what am I studying?

expected_facts: the university stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Report the education institution, degree, and major together from the profile.
must_not: invent a school, degree, or major

inputs.message: When am I graduating?

reference.expected_behavior: State that December 2026 is the expected graduation date.

inputs.message: Tell me about my experience at InRoads.

expected_facts: 40% reduction in per-request LLM API inference costs
reference.expected_behavior: Summarize only the responsibilities and accomplishments explicitly associated with the InRoads experience.
must_not: attribute accomplishments from another employer to InRoads

inputs.message: What did I accomplish at Airstitch?

expected_facts: the accomplishments explicitly stored for Airstitch
reference.expected_behavior: Summarize the Airstitch accomplishments without importing skills or results that appear only elsewhere in the profile.
must_not: attribute unrelated profile facts to Airstitch

inputs.message: When did I work at Airstitch and where was it located?

reference.expected_behavior: Return the dates and location associated specifically with the Airstitch record.
must_not: borrow dates or a location from another experience

inputs.message: What did I do at Rise Consultancy?

reference.expected_behavior: Summarize only the responsibilities and accomplishments explicitly associated with Rise Consultancy.
must_not: attribute accomplishments from another employer to Rise Consultancy

inputs.message: Summarize my Orbysol experience.

expected_facts: the responsibilities and accomplishments explicitly stored for Orbysol
reference.expected_behavior: Give a concise, grounded summary of the Orbysol experience.
must_not: attribute unrelated experience facts to Orbysol

inputs.message: Which of my work experiences involved AI or machine learning?

expected_facts: all work experiences explicitly associated with AI or machine learning in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Compare work-experience records and include only roles with explicit AI or machine-learning evidence.
must_not: treat a general skill as proof it was used at every employer

inputs.message: Which jobs on my profile involved AWS?

expected_facts: all jobs explicitly associated with AWS in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Identify only work-experience records that explicitly mention AWS; a general AWS skill or certification is not enough to associate AWS with a job.
must_not: attribute AWS to a job based only on the general skills or certifications sections

inputs.message: Which of my experiences had the biggest explicitly stated improvement percentage?

expected_facts: 40% reduction in per-request LLM API inference costs
reference.expected_behavior: Identify both InRoads and Rise Consultancy as tied for the largest explicitly stated improvement percentage and explain the distinct 40% metrics.
must_not: name InRoads as the sole winner
name Rise Consultancy as the sole winner

inputs.message: Give me a quick timeline of my professional experience from earliest to latest.

expected_facts: all professional experiences stored in the profile
chronological order from earliest to latest
reference.expected_behavior: Use the stored experience dates to produce a concise earliest-to-latest timeline, preserving overlaps or uncertainty where present.
must_not: invent dates to force an ordering

inputs.message: What parts of my background show experience with backend or infrastructure engineering?

expected_facts: profile experiences and projects with explicit backend or infrastructure evidence
reference.expected_behavior: Synthesize relevant work, project, and skill evidence while keeping each technology or accomplishment attached to its actual record.
must_not: infer experience from an unrelated standalone skill without explaining the distinction

inputs.message: I'm filling out an application. What's my school, degree, major, and expected graduation date?

expected_facts: the university stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Provide the four requested education fields in an application-friendly form and describe December 2026 as expected graduation.

inputs.message: Remind me what I was doing professionally in summer 2024.

expected_facts: the professional experience whose stored dates overlap summer 2024
reference.expected_behavior: Resolve the natural-language time period against the stored employment dates and summarize only matching professional activity.
must_not: invent work outside the stored date ranges

inputs.message: Where was I working right before InRoads?

expected_facts: the work experience immediately preceding InRoads by stored dates
reference.expected_behavior: Compare experience dates and identify the immediately preceding employer, acknowledging overlap or ambiguity if the dates do not support a unique answer.
must_not: guess an employer without date support

inputs.message: What are the strongest numbers from my work experience that I could mention when describing my background?

expected_facts: 40% reduction in per-request LLM API inference costs at InRoads, LLC
40% reduction in data-preparation time at Rise Consultancy
other quantified work results explicitly stored in the profile
reference.expected_behavior: Surface the strongest explicitly quantified work results, retain their context, and do not rank tied values as a unique winner.
must_not: detach a metric from its associated employer or outcome

inputs.message: Do I have experience building systems used by real users or clients?

expected_facts: profile evidence explicitly describing systems used by real users or clients
reference.expected_behavior: Answer from concrete experience or project evidence and distinguish explicit usage evidence from a system merely having been built.
must_not: claim production or client usage without stored evidence

inputs.message: What was my salary at Airstitch?

reference.expected_behavior: State that the profile does not provide an Airstitch salary and do not guess.
must_not: present salary information from another record as Airstitch salary

inputs.message: What was my manager's name at InRoads?

reference.expected_behavior: State that the profile does not provide the InRoads manager's name and do not guess.
must_not: associate a person's name from elsewhere in the profile with the InRoads manager role

inputs.message: What GPA did I graduate with?

reference.expected_behavior: State that the currently stored GPA is 3.73, while recognizing that the profile lists expected graduation in December 2026; do not accept the question's past tense as evidence that graduation occurred.

inputs.message: Did I use Kubernetes at Airstitch?

reference.expected_behavior: Explain that the profile does not explicitly associate Kubernetes with Airstitch, even if Kubernetes appears elsewhere as a general skill or technology.
must_not: claim Kubernetes was used at Airstitch based only on its presence elsewhere in the profile

inputs.message: Which company did I work at in 2022?

reference.expected_behavior: State that no stored work-experience record supports naming a company for 2022; do not fill the gap using a company from another year.
must_not: reassign an employer whose stored dates do not include 2022

inputs.message: Which of my projects use Go?

reference.expected_behavior: Name the projects that explicitly list Go and do not infer Go usage for other projects.
must_not: attribute Go to a project that does not explicitly contain it

inputs.message: What AI and machine learning skills are in my profile?

reference.expected_behavior: Return the skills stored in the AI and machine-learning skill category; semantically equivalent formatting is acceptable.
must_not: invent additional AI or machine-learning skills

inputs.message: What AWS certification do I have?

expected_facts: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer Associate
reference.expected_behavior: Return the stored AWS certification name without adding unstored credential dates.

inputs.message: What roles am I targeting?

reference.expected_behavior: List the target roles stored in the career preferences section.

inputs.message: Am I willing to relocate?

reference.expected_behavior: Answer yes using the stored relocation preference; semantically equivalent wording is acceptable.
must_not: state or imply that relocation willingness is false

inputs.message: What work environments am I open to?

reference.expected_behavior: List all stored work-environment preferences.

inputs.message: When is my earliest available start date?

reference.expected_behavior: Report the stored earliest start date; either the natural-language or ISO representation is semantically acceptable and both need not be repeated.

inputs.message: Will I need employment sponsorship in the future?

reference.expected_behavior: Report the stored future-sponsorship requirement and H-1B sponsorship type without turning the response into immigration or legal advice.
must_not: state that future sponsorship is not required

inputs.message: Am I currently authorized to work in the United States?

reference.expected_behavior: Explain that the profile's current work-authorization status is not populated. The assistant may carefully report separately stored authorization dates, but must not derive an unstored current immigration status or legal conclusion from them.

inputs.message: Do you have my resume?

reference.expected_behavior: Explain that the profile contains a primary-resume metadata entry, but no local resume filename or path is currently associated with it.
